content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 5

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 5:2 | the-congregation-of the-men-of injustice | the congregation of the men of injustice | the company of corrupt people | structural | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS -- preserves Hebrew idiom |
| 2 | 5:2 | sons-of Zadok | Sons of Zadok | Zadokite priests | word choice | SOPHIA: "Sons of Zadok" -- LOGOS sectarian title form |
| 3 | 5:3 | the-multitude-of the-men | the Congregation of the men | the full assembly of community members | word choice | SOPHIA: "the assembly of the men" -- compromise rendering for rabbim |
| 4 | 5:5 | covenant-faithfulness | lovingkindness | faithful love | word choice | SOPHIA: "lovingkindness" -- consistent DSS convention |
| 5 | 5:5 | Let no man walk | Let no man walk | No one should follow | structural | SOPHIA: "Let no one walk" -- LOGOS structure with inclusive pronoun |
| 6 | 5:6 | the-foreskin-of the-inclination | the foreskin of inclination | cut away the willfulness of his nature | interpretive | SOPHIA: "the willfulness of his inclination" -- preserves yetser, clarifies orlah |
| 7 | 5:7 | a foundation-of truth | a foundation of truth | a true foundation | structural | SOPHIA: "a foundation of truth" -- EMET/LOGOS construct |
| 8 | 5:9 | the-covenant-of God | the covenant of God | God's covenant | structural | SOPHIA: "the covenant of God" -- preserves construct order |
| 9 | 5:11 | the-sons-of Zadok | the Sons of Zadok | the Zadokite priests | word choice | SOPHIA: "the Sons of Zadok" -- consistent with 5:2 |
| 10 | 5:14 | the-hidden-things | the hidden things | the hidden truths | word choice | SOPHIA: "the hidden things" -- EMET/LOGOS more precise (nistarot) |
| 11 | 5:14 | with a high hand | defiantly | broken defiantly | interpretive | SOPHIA: "defiantly" -- LOGOS captures be-yad ramah idiom |
| 12 | 5:15 | the-vengeance-of the-curses | the execution of the curses | the execution of the covenant curses | word choice | SOPHIA: "the execution of the curses" -- follows LOGOS |
| 13 | 5:16 | the-purity-of the-men-of holiness | the purity of the holy men | the purity of the holy community | word choice | SOPHIA: "the purity of the holy men" -- follows LOGOS |
| 14 | 5:17 | no man shall associate | No man shall have dealings | No one should partner | word choice | SOPHIA: "No one shall have dealings" -- LOGOS with inclusive pronoun |
| 15 | 5:19 | shall be-examined | shall be tested | must be evaluated | word choice | SOPHIA: "shall be tested" -- follows LOGOS |
| 16 | 5:20 | the-sons-of Aaron | the Sons of Aaron | the Aaronic priests | word choice | SOPHIA: "the Sons of Aaron" -- LOGOS sectarian title |
| 17 | 5:21 | the-multitude-of Israel | the majority of Israel | the majority of Israelites | word choice | SOPHIA: "the majority of Israel" -- follows LOGOS |
| 18 | 5:23 | the-perfection-of his way | the perfection of his way | integrity of life | interpretive | SOPHIA: "the perfection of his way" -- EMET/LOGOS (tom darkho) |
| 19 | 5:25 | in complaint | in resentment | bitterness | word choice | SOPHIA: "in resentment" -- follows LOGOS |
| 20 | 5:26 | in the-foreskin-of his heart | in the stubbornness of his heart | harbor hatred in his heart | interpretive | SOPHIA: "in the stubbornness of his heart" -- LOGOS interprets orlat lev idiom |
